about: Students a service trains (training.md): which family each belongs to, and the family's picture rule. Everything else (tokens, template, picture numbers) is read from the student's own published files. A student matches a family when its id, up to the first ':', starts with one of the family's prefixes.

unpublished.thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Small: Thinking Machines will publish its weights and files (announced 2026-11-05); until then Python renders it with tml-renderers (h200k tokens) and Inkling-Small's template, which is the same format

efforts.about: Inkling's thinking-effort presets, as Tinker documents them (cookbook/inkling/thinking-effort); a bake's effort may be a number in [0, 0.99] or one of these names.
